title: Harvest Day
description: Help us make this our biggest day of the year! Start inviting your family, friends, neighbors and coworkers now. We'll have a great service, a big meal afterward, games, fun and fellowship for everyone. If you have ideas or would like to help organize an activity, please see Pastor. Let's work together to have a high attendance day and reach people for the Lord!
location: Victory Baptist Church - 295 Pleasant View Drive, Kittanning, PA 16201
